commitMessage:
Bug 458804 - [content assist] Contribute postfix code completion to JDT

[rgrunber@redhat.com: Additional changes to Postfix Completion]

- Make Postfix Completion Feature use proper JDT API.
o.e.jdt.internal.compiler.ast.ASTNode -> o.e.jdt.core.dom.ASTNode
o.e.jdt.internal.compiler.lookup.Binding -> o.e.jdt.core.dom.IBinding
- Use CompletionContext getTokenStart(), getTokenEnd() to compute prefix
key more accurately

Given an IJavaElement that encloses a completion invocation
(CompletionContext), a better ASTNode can be found by visiting every
child of the ASTNode corresponding to that IJavaElement and selecting
the one that is closest to the invocation offset

CQ: 20875
Change-Id: I955a89371891d40bc9019612cadc3f1504793cbc
Signed-off-by: Nicolaj Hoess <nicohoess@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Roland Grunberg <rgrunber@redhat.com>
summary: The commit adds postfix code completion feature and its configuration; no direct code transformation is identified that fits the DSL.

commitMessage:
Bug 547197 - [9][model] API to get the kind of a IModuleDescription

migrate to the final API

Change-Id: Iedd79b341b3f4849e5876d6cd5573933cd0612eb
dslRule:
<!id: jdt.core.api.migrate.isSystemModule>
<!description: Migrate from provisional JavaModelAccess.isSystemModule() to the final IModuleDescription.isSystemModule() API (Java 9+).
This change reflects the stabilization of the Java module API within JDT Core.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.provisional.JavaModelAccess.isSystemModule($module) :: sourceVersionGE(9) && instanceof($module, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IModuleDescription")
=> $module.isSystemModule()
;;
